title: What Is IMPS? Full Form, Transfer Process, Limits and Advantages
summary: Learn the IMPS full form, how to transfer money using IMPS, its ₹5 lakh per-transaction limit, bank charges, benefits and how to check transaction status.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


Toggle


Transferring funds in real-time and around the clock was a huge challenge in banking.[NEFT and RTGS](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/imps-vs-neft-vs-rtgs/) once operated during set banking hours. With this in mind, the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) launched IMPS, which stands for Immediate Payment Service. IMPS facilitates fund transfers 24×7, 365 days a year, across India. NEFT and RTGS now also operate around the clock.


IMPS participants include banks and[PPIs](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/ppi-interoperability/) . IMPS can be used for instant domestic fund transfer services. The[NPCI per-transaction limit](https://www.npci.org.in/product/IMPS) is ₹5 lakh for channels other than SMS and IVR. Banks may set lower transaction or daily limits.


### TL;DR


- IMPS stands for Immediate Payment Service. It enables instant money transfers across India, including weekends and bank holidays.
- The limit is ₹5 lakh per transaction for channels other than SMS and IVR. Your bank may apply a lower limit and its own charges.
- Use the beneficiary’s account number and IFSC, or their mobile number and MMID where your bank supports that option.


##


What Are the Benefits of IMPS?


IMPS is one of the most accessible, cost-effective and secure means of money transfer. The benefits of IMPS are listed below.


- **Multiple access and ease of use.** IMPS can be transacted through mobile phones as well as internet banking anywhere and anytime, including bank holidays.
- **Instant transfer of funds.** Money transfer happens in real-time under normal conditions. Check the transaction status if technical issues cause a delay.
- **Low transaction cost.** Subject to the transaction amount and the policy of the bank through which IMPS transactions are done, charges may be waived or a fee may apply. Check your bank’s current charges, including applicable GST.
- **Accessibility.** IMPS transfers using the mobile number route require details like mobile number and MMID (Mobile Money Identifier) which is a unique 7-digit number of which the first 4-digits are unique identification of the bank offering IMPS. IMPS transacted through internet banking or a mobile app can also use details like bank account number and[IFSC code](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-ifsc-code/) .


To use the MMID route, activate the required mobile banking service with your bank. For account number and IFSC transfers, the beneficiary does not need to give you an MMID.


##


Who Participates in an IMPS Transaction?


Each IMPS transaction involves the following parties:


- Sender (Remitter)
- Receiver (Beneficiary)
- Bank
- NPCI, which operates IMPS


##


Prerequisites for IMPS Through Mobile Banking


The registration steps below apply to the mobile number and MMID route, where offered by your bank.


### Registration for the Sender


- Activate mobile banking service of the bank.
- Get MMID (Mobile Money Identifier) and the required authentication credentials from the bank, where applicable.
- Download the mobile banking app or use the SMS facility if your bank offers IMPS via SMS.


### Registration for the Receiver


- Link your mobile number to the bank account.
- Obtain MMID (Mobile Money Identifier) from the bank.


##


How to Transfer Funds via IMPS


Fund transfer/remittance through IMPS can be done using the following options, where your bank supports them.


- **Mobile number & MMID (P2P)** : Register your mobile number with the bank and obtain the MMID required for this route. The receiver must provide their bank-registered mobile number and MMID.
- **Account number & IFSC code (P2A)** : In cases where the receiver’s mobile number is not registered with a bank account, IMPS transfer is not possible using Mobile Number & MMID. It is made possible using the receiver’s bank account number & IFSC code.


Follow these steps to carry out fund transfers through IMPS.


**Step 1** : Log in to the banking app, select the IMPS from the transfer or payment method or use the SMS facility if your bank offers IMPS on SMS.


**Step 2** : Enter the receiver’s/beneficiary’s mobile number & MMID or bank account number & IFSC code, followed by the amount. Confirm the details and authenticate using the method required by your bank.


**Step 3** : You will receive a confirmation message on the screen and SMS.


**Step 4** : Note the transaction reference number for future use.


If due to technical issues, the amount is not transferred instantly, check the status and raise a complaint with your bank. Under the[RBI failed transaction framework](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/FS_Notification.aspx?Id=11693&Mode=0&fn=9) , an IMPS debit that cannot be credited to the beneficiary must be reversed by T+1, where T is the calendar date of the transaction. Compensation of ₹100 per day applies for delay beyond T+1.


However, it is important to note that you must always check the details like the[beneficiary’s account number](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/verify-account-holder-name/) , IFSC, mobile number and MMID. If money reaches the wrong account, contact your bank immediately. Recovery can depend on the recipient’s cooperation and the bank’s recovery process.


##


IMPS Transaction Status and Tracking


Once the transfer under IMPS is complete, the IMPS reference number is generated and provided. The IMPS reference number is a unique reference number for every IMPS transaction. The status of the IMPS transaction can be tracked on the mobile banking app or the bank website using the IMPS reference number.


##


Frequently Asked Questions


#### What Is IMPS and Its Full Form?


Immediate Payment Service facilitates fund transfers 24×7, 365 days a year, across India through banks and RBI-authorized Prepaid Payment Instrument Issuers (PPI).


#### What is the limit for IMPS?


The IMPS limit per transaction is ₹5 lakh (for all channels except SMS and IVR). Your bank may apply a lower transaction or daily limit. You may contact your bank for further information.


#### What services are available through IMPS?


- Sending and Receiving money
- Beneficiary account checking functionality
- Transaction status-checking functionality
- The domestic leg of foreign inward remittance through authorised providers


#### Which channels are available for fund transfer using IMPS?


The following channels may be used to initiate IMPS transactions, depending on the services offered by your bank.


1. Mobile Banking App/SMS
2. Internet- Net banking facility
3. ATM
4. Bank branch


#### What is MMID? How to get an MMID issued?


MMID, or Mobile Money Identifier, is a unique 7-digit number, issued by banks. The first 4 digits identify the bank offering the service, and the last 3 digits distinguish accounts linked to the same mobile number. You may contact your bank to obtain MMID.


#### Is the Facility to Stop Payments Available on IMPS?


No, payment cannot be stopped or cancelled after initiating a payment.


#### What are the charges for IMPS transactions?


The charges vary from bank to bank and by account type, channel and transfer amount. Some IMPS transactions are free, while others attract a fee plus GST. Check your bank’s charges before confirming the transfer.


#### Can I link multiple accounts to the same mobile number for MMID?


Yes, you can link more than one account to a mobile number. However, different MMIDs will be issued for each account number.
